metadata.description: An explicit edge to dbx-cli:build-base, NOT `^build`. This entry point compiles into the parent's dist directory, which `dbx-cli:build-base` deletes and rewrites (rollup `deleteOutputPath: true`), so it cannot run before the parent -- but the edge has to be spelled out, because `^build` here would resolve to dbx-cli:build, which depends on this very target: a hard cycle. That XOR is the whole design constraint -- either the children get `^build` or the parent aggregates them, never both. Aggregating is the side that keeps one writer per dist directory.  This one has no source import of @dereekb/dbx-cli at all -- the parent edge here is purely the nested-output ordering edge (plan 2.4): its bundle lands in dist/packages/dbx-cli/lint-cache, inside a directory dbx-cli:build-base deletes wholesale. Its util:build edge is new too; nothing previously ordered this bundle behind the dist it compiles against.
